case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 34-year-old woman, 3 months of palpitations, tremor, sweating and weight loss of 6 kg despite a good appetite. A previous clinic called it an anxiety disorder. HR 112, regular. Fine tremor, warm moist hands, a smooth enlarged thyroid. TSH below 0.01 mU/L, free T4 raised. Not pregnant.

must_catch.why: The earlier anxiety label is a tempting anchor.
